The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest is an upcoming Hindi fantasy-thriller built around Indian folklore, a forbidden forest, an ancient divine force, and the clash between modern rationalism and ancestral belief.

Starring Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia, the film brings together Balaji Motion Pictures, The Viral Fever (TVF), and 11:11 Productions for a story that aims to mix mystery, mythology, fantasy, action, adventure, suspense, and supernatural elements.

The film is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical release on September 25, 2026. Its latest teaser has already pushed the movie into the social-media conversation, especially because of its unusual folklore-driven premise and the scale of the world being teased.

Release Date

The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest is scheduled to arrive in cinemas on September 25, 2026. The film had previously been associated with an August 28 release, but the makers later announced the September date.

What Is The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest About?

At the centre of The Vvaan is a man who believes in logic.

He comes from an urban, modern world and does not easily accept the supernatural beliefs of his ancestral village.

When he returns to his family's roots, he encounters warnings about a forest that the villagers consider forbidden and sacred.

He initially treats those warnings as superstition.

Then he crosses the boundary.

That decision changes everything.

According to the published synopsis, entering the forbidden forest awakens an ancient divine force described as goddess-like. The protagonist is then forced to confront events that cannot be explained through the rational worldview he previously trusted.

What begins as disbelief develops into a much larger struggle involving:

  • Ancestral beliefs
  • Indian folklore
  • A mysterious forest
  • A supernatural presence
  • Faith versus rationalism
  • The survival of a community
  • A reluctant transformation into a protector

The story is deliberately keeping many details hidden, which makes the central mystery one of the film's biggest attractions.

The Central Idea: Logic vs Faith

One of the most interesting things about The Vvaan is not simply the presence of supernatural forces.

It is the conflict between two worldviews.

On one side is modernity.

The protagonist approaches the world through logic and rational explanation.

On the other side is a village culture shaped by generations of stories, traditions, warnings, and beliefs connected to the forest.

The film places those two worlds directly against each other.

That gives The Vvaan a potentially richer foundation than a conventional creature or haunted-forest story.

The question is not merely:

"What is inside the forest?"

It is also:

"What happens when a person who does not believe in the supernatural becomes impossible to separate from it?"

Why Is The Vvaan Trending?

The movie has been attracting attention for several reasons.

First, it reunites a major Hindi-film lead pair in a genre that is relatively unusual for mainstream Bollywood.

Second, the story is rooted in Indian folklore instead of relying entirely on an established international fantasy property.

Third, the filmmakers are presenting The Vvaan as a world with its own mythology.

And finally, the official teaser released on August 25, 2026 gave audiences their first substantial visual look at the film.

The teaser immediately raised questions around the forest, the divine presence, Sidharth Malhotra's character, and the larger mythology behind the title.

The official promotional material also confirms the September 25 theatrical release.

Sidharth Malhotra as the Central Character

Sidharth Malhotra leads the film as the rational urban man at the heart of the story.

That character setup gives him a different kind of challenge from a straightforward action hero.

He begins as someone who trusts reason more than folklore.

But The Vvaan appears designed to gradually strip away that certainty.

The forest becomes more than a location.

It becomes the force that challenges everything he thinks he knows.

The central character therefore has an emotional journey as well as a physical one:

Modern city life
      ↓
Return to ancestral roots
      ↓
Dismissal of local beliefs
      ↓
Entry into the forbidden forest
      ↓
Encounter with the supernatural
      ↓
Crisis
      ↓
Transformation
      ↓
Protector of his people

That transformation is one of the most important elements to watch when the film arrives.

Tamannaah Bhatia's Role

Tamannaah Bhatia joins Sidharth Malhotra as the female lead.

The makers have been relatively careful about revealing detailed character information, which suggests that her role may be closely connected to the film's larger mystery.

Rather than giving away the character's complete arc before release, the promotional campaign has focused more heavily on the film's world, atmosphere, folklore, and central conflict.

That leaves plenty of room for the theatrical film to reveal how her character fits into the mythology.

Who Directed The Vvaan?

The film is associated with Arunabh Kumar and Deepak Kumar Mishra.

Arunabh Kumar is one of the founders and key creative figures behind The Viral Fever, while Deepak Kumar Mishra is known for his work in TVF productions.

The combination is particularly notable.

TVF built its reputation around character-driven stories, grounded settings, relatable humour, and strong writing.

The Vvaan moves into a much larger cinematic space involving folklore, fantasy, supernatural mystery, action, and visual world-building.

That makes the film an interesting creative expansion for the TVF ecosystem.

Who Wrote The Vvaan?

The screenplay and story are credited to Arunabh Kumar, while dialogue is credited to Anandeshwar Dwivedi in the current promotional credits.

The story appears to balance two worlds:

modern urban rationalism

and

traditional folklore and supernatural belief.

That thematic contrast is likely to drive much of the movie rather than simply serving as background decoration.

Who Produced The Vvaan?

The Vvaan is being presented by Balaji Motion Pictures, in association with TVF Motion Pictures and 11:11 Productions.

The current producer credits include:

  • Shobha Kapoor
  • Ektaa R Kapoor
  • Arunabh Kumar
  • Niraj Kothari

This collaboration is one of the film's most interesting industry angles.

Balaji brings decades of mainstream Hindi entertainment experience, while TVF brings a modern digital storytelling identity and a strong history of character-led Indian narratives.

The Vvaan therefore sits at an unusual intersection between mainstream Bollywood spectacle and TVF's storytelling sensibilities.

The World of The Vvaan

A major selling point of the film is its world.

The story is not set against a generic fantasy landscape.

It is rooted in an Indian village, an ancestral connection, a forbidden forest, and folklore surrounding a powerful divine presence.

That gives the film an opportunity to build mythology from Indian cultural references rather than importing a fantasy vocabulary from Western cinema.

The forest appears to function almost like a character itself.

It represents:

  • Memory
  • Fear
  • Faith
  • Nature
  • Ancestry
  • The unknown
  • The supernatural

And that creates a strong thematic question:

Can humanity control a force it does not understand?

The Folklore Behind The Story

The film's premise draws from the long tradition of Indian folklore in which forests, village boundaries, sacred spaces, local deities, spirits, and ancestral stories are closely connected.

The Vvaan is not presented as a direct adaptation of one famous mythological story.

Instead, its premise appears to create an original fictional mythology inspired by Indian folklore.

That distinction is important.

The film is attempting to build a new cinematic world while using familiar cultural ideas about sacred forests, divine forces, and the relationship between humans and nature.

The Vvaan Is More Than a Horror Movie

Some entertainment listings have described the film as horror or horror-thriller.

IMDb currently classifies it across:

  • Action
  • Fantasy
  • Mystery
  • Thriller

Other descriptions emphasize mythology, folklore, adventure, and supernatural elements.

The safest description is therefore:

a folklore-driven fantasy thriller with supernatural and horror elements.

That combination could make the movie feel very different from a conventional Bollywood horror film.

The focus appears to be on mythology, mystery, adventure, action, and world-building rather than horror alone.

A Major Production Decision: The Additional Shoot

The film reportedly underwent an additional 10-day shoot focused particularly on the climax and several important sequences.

According to reports, the creative team reviewed the final cut and concluded that certain scenes could be made larger, more dramatic, and more impactful for theatrical audiences.

Instead of simply accepting the existing cut, the filmmakers chose to revisit selected portions of the movie.

That suggests the climax is expected to be an important part of the theatrical experience.

For a film built around supernatural mystery, the final act can determine whether the mythology feels satisfying or underwhelming.

The additional shooting therefore becomes a noteworthy production detail.

Why the Reshoot Matters

The reported additional schedule was intended to strengthen key scenes and the climax, with the goal of delivering a larger theatrical payoff rather than simply changing the film's basic story.

The Vvaan and The Legend of Vvan Comic Book

One of the more unusual aspects of the project is that the creators have been developing a broader mythology around Vvan.

At Mumbai Comic Con 2026, the team introduced The Legend of Vvan, a comic book connected to the film's world.

That is significant because the filmmakers are not treating The Vvaan only as a standalone movie.

The comic gives audiences an early glimpse into the fictional mythology behind the film.

It also suggests that the creators may be interested in building a larger story universe around Vvan.

That could eventually expand into:

  • Additional stories
  • More characters
  • New folklore
  • Spin-off material
  • Future films or entertainment properties

At this point, however, the broader universe should be viewed as an ambition rather than a confirmed multi-film franchise.

The Vvaan Release Date

The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest is currently scheduled for a September 25, 2026 theatrical release.

The release date has changed during the film's journey.

It was previously associated with:

May 15, 2026

and later:

August 28, 2026.

The makers subsequently announced the revised date:

September 25, 2026.

The current promotional campaign from Balaji Motion Pictures also carries the September 25 date.

Why the September Release Matters

The September release places the film in a period when audiences are already following several major 2026 theatrical releases.

That makes the film's strongest weapon its uniqueness.

A conventional action film has to compete on scale.

A conventional romantic film has to compete on chemistry.

The Vvaan has something different to sell:

an original Indian folklore mystery built around a forbidden forest and a divine force.

Where Can You Watch The Vvaan?

The Vvaan is currently intended as a theatrical movie.

The film is not yet available for streaming because its theatrical release has not happened.

The project was announced as part of Prime Video's 2026 slate, and multiple movie databases and entertainment listings associate the film with Prime Video.

However, the official digital streaming date has not been announced.

For now, the theatrical release is the date to watch:

September 25, 2026.

What Makes The Vvaan Interesting?

There are several reasons this film stands out.

1. An Original Folklore Concept

Instead of adapting a well-known superhero or remaking an existing property, The Vvaan attempts to create a new mythology rooted in Indian folklore.

2. Sidharth Malhotra in a Supernatural World

The actor is moving into a genre where his character's transformation appears to be as important as physical action.

3. Tamannaah Bhatia in a Darker Fantasy Setting

The film gives Tamannaah a very different backdrop from many of her recent mainstream projects.

4. TVF Meets Balaji

The partnership brings together two very different storytelling traditions.

5. A Large Ensemble

The cast combines mainstream stars with experienced television and character actors.

6. A World Built Beyond the Film

The Legend of Vvan comic suggests that the mythology has been designed with a larger world in mind.

7. The Forest Itself

The most intriguing "character" may not be a person.

It may be the forest.

What Should Audiences Expect From The Vvaan?

Without revealing details the filmmakers have intentionally kept hidden, viewers can reasonably expect a combination of:

Mystery + Folklore + Fantasy + Supernatural Threat + Action + Adventure + Emotional Transformation

The movie appears designed to begin with a familiar human conflict and gradually expand into something much larger.

The protagonist starts by asking whether supernatural stories can possibly be real.

By the end, he may have to answer a very different question:

What responsibility does a person have when the world they inherited turns out to be real?

What the Teaser Tells Us

The teaser deliberately avoids explaining the entire mythology.

Instead, it focuses on atmosphere.

The forest looks dangerous.

The village feels shaped by something older than the protagonist's modern worldview.

The presence of a divine or supernatural force becomes increasingly difficult to ignore.

The promotional imagery also uses strong animal and religious symbolism, including the contrast between the tiger and the bull/Nandi imagery that appeared in the film's later motion-poster campaign.

That symbolism creates an important suggestion:

the conflict in The Vvaan may be bigger than a simple battle between humans and a supernatural creature.

Is The Vvaan Based on a Real Indian Myth?

There is currently no indication that The Vvaan is a direct retelling of one specific classical Hindu myth.

The story is better understood as an original fictional narrative inspired by Indian folklore, mythology, sacred spaces, village traditions, and supernatural storytelling.

That distinction matters because viewers may encounter familiar cultural symbols without the movie being a literal adaptation of a traditional scripture or historical legend.

Is The Vvaan Connected to Hindu Mythology?

The movie uses themes associated with Indian mythology and folklore, including divine forces, sacred spaces, forest legends, and religious symbolism.

However, the publicly available synopsis presents the story as a fictional folklore-inspired thriller rather than a direct adaptation of a specific Hindu scripture.

The film's use of these elements appears intended to create a new cinematic mythology.

Why The Vvaan Could Be Important for Indian Cinema

Indian cinema has a long history of stories involving folklore, mythology, local deities, spirits, sacred landscapes, and supernatural traditions.

But many such stories have traditionally remained associated with regional cinema.

The Vvaan attempts to bring that kind of folklore-driven storytelling into a mainstream Hindi theatrical film with major stars and large-scale production values.

That makes it worth watching beyond its cast.

Its larger experiment is:

Can an original Indian folklore universe become a mainstream cinematic event?

The Vvaan: Expectations vs Reality

The film has generated significant curiosity, but expectations should remain realistic.

The concept looks distinctive.

The cast is recognizable.

The teaser has created visual interest.

The makers have invested additional effort into the climax.

But the final quality of the movie will depend on execution.

A strong folklore concept alone is not enough.

The Vvaan will ultimately need:

  • A convincing mythology
  • Strong character development
  • Effective world-building
  • Good visual effects
  • A satisfying mystery
  • A meaningful emotional arc
  • A climax that delivers on the setup

That is what audiences should ultimately judge.

Final Verdict

The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest could become one of the more unusual Hindi films of 2026.

Not because it has the biggest star.

Not because it is simply another action movie.

And not because it is attempting to imitate a Western fantasy universe.

Its appeal comes from something more specific:

it is trying to create a new cinematic mythology around Indian folklore.

Sidharth Malhotra's rational protagonist gives the audience a way into the story.

Tamannaah Bhatia adds another major presence to the world.

The supporting cast brings experience across film, television, comedy, and character-driven storytelling.

And the forest gives the entire movie its central mystery.

The most exciting possibility is that The Vvaan does not simply tell us about a supernatural force.

It makes us question whether the things a modern person dismisses as superstition might sometimes represent something much older, deeper, and harder to explain.

The answer arrives in cinemas on:

September 25, 2026

The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest — a new Indian folklore-driven fantasy thriller.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest?

The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest is an upcoming Hindi fantasy-thriller inspired by Indian folklore. It follows a rational city-bred man who returns to his ancestral village and enters a forbidden forest, awakening a powerful supernatural force.

Who stars in The Vvaan?

The film stars Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia in the lead roles. The supporting cast includes Anup Soni, Shweta Tiwari, Sunil Grover, Maniesh Paul, Durgesh Kumar, Sundip Ved, Akshaan Sehrawat, Ajay Raju, and Aniket Sanghavi.

Who is directing The Vvaan?

The film is associated with directors Deepak Kumar Mishra and Arunabh Kumar. Current promotional and database credits list both filmmakers.

Who wrote The Vvaan?

Arunabh Kumar is credited with the story, screenplay, and writing, while Anandeshwar Dwivedi is credited for dialogue in the current promotional credits.

When is The Vvaan releasing?

The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest is scheduled to release in cinemas on September 25, 2026.

Is The Vvaan a horror movie?

The film is variously described as a fantasy, thriller, mystery, action, adventure, and horror/supernatural film. The most accurate broad description is a folklore-driven fantasy thriller with supernatural and horror elements.

Is The Vvaan based on a true story?

No publicly available material indicates that The Vvaan is based on a specific true story. It is presented as an original fictional narrative inspired by Indian folklore and mythology.

Is The Vvaan based on Hindu mythology?

The movie draws inspiration from Indian folklore, divine imagery, sacred spaces, and mythology-related themes. However, it is not presented as a direct adaptation of a particular Hindu scripture or classical myth.

What is the story of The Vvaan?

The story follows a rational urban man who returns to his ancestral village and rejects warnings about a forbidden forest. After entering the forest, he awakens an ancient divine force and becomes involved in a larger struggle to protect his people.

Is The Vvaan connected to a comic book?

Yes. The makers introduced The Legend of Vvan, a comic book that expands the mythology surrounding the film's world.

Will The Vvaan have an OTT release?

A digital streaming date has not been officially announced. The film is first planned as a theatrical release.

Where can I watch The Vvaan trailer?

The official teaser is available on YouTube through the promotional channels associated with the film.

Why is The Vvaan generating buzz?

The film combines Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia, an original Indian folklore concept, supernatural mystery, TVF and Balaji's collaboration, a large ensemble cast, and an ambitious cinematic world.
